Flytower has a new home on GitHub: [teamflytower/flytower](https://github.com/teamflytower/flytower). From 1.4.3 the panel checks for updates there and the agent downloads them from there. The old address still redirects, so older versions keep updating as before, and nothing changes for your servers. If you keep a copy of the install command, swap `MattA-Official/mc-panel` for `teamflytower/flytower`; the old one keeps working.

Testing: update a test box from 1.4.2, check **System** still lists updates, and run the installer from the new address on a spare VPS.
